# Volume Time, VWAP, and Participation Strategies {#plan-ch10}

::: {.planned-chapter}
Source draft
:::

Connects optimal liquidation to the schedules and constraints used by practical execution algorithms.

**Subtopics.** Calendar time and volume time; TWAP and VWAP schedules; constant and time-varying POV; uncertain future volume; participation caps and floors; completion constraints; catch-up logic near deadlines; benchmark-aware control; realized versus intended participation; interaction among impact, volume forecasts, and alpha decay.
